notes.title: Performance Improvements
notes.content:
Hey there! We have done some really crucial performance improvements in the enemies A.I of all maps!
This should fix some crashes issues that some players were facing.

- Every enemy A.I was re-done from scratch 
- New pause system with more clean code (not visual) 
- Load from one map to another is now more consistent

That's all! If encounter any bugs, feel free to tell us in the community chat of the game!
Thank you all for playing it!
